recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的骨髓顆粒（particle）幾乎由脂肪空泡與細網狀基質組成，造血細胞稀疏，顯示骨髓細胞量明顯減少（hypocellular particle）。
features: Low-power view of a marrow particle composed predominantly of fat vacuoles
Thin, dark-staining stromal strands forming a lacy network between fat spaces
Sparse hematopoietic cells scattered along the stroma
No sheets of blasts or abnormal cellular aggregates identified at this magnification
Individual cell morphology and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a particle composed predominantly of adipocytes with a delicate stromal network and only scattered hematopoietic cells, indicating markedly decreased particle cellularity. Cytologic detail and dysplasia cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Hypocellularity should be confirmed on the core biopsy. In a patient with cytopenias and documented dysplasia or MDS-defining cytogenetics, findings are consistent with hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows similarly fatty particles, so separation depends on absence of dysplasia, blasts and MDS-defining cytogenetic abnormalities on high-power review and karyotype.
A hemodilute specimen has few or no particles and a peripheral-blood-like cell population, whereas here a true particle is present and is itself fatty.
Age-appropriate or therapy-induced hypocellularity lacks persistent dysplasia and clonal abnormalities and correlates with age and treatment history.
